title: Salesforce Developer
description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 20 September 2026**Job Description**

  



**Title:**Salesforce Developer


**Department:** **FIL Canada, India**

**Location:**Gurgaon

**Reports To:**Application Development and Support Lead

**Level:**Grade 4

**About Fidelity International**

We’ve been helping clients plan and save for their futures for over 50 years. From more than 25 locations around the world, we provide investment services and retirement expertise to everyone from central banks and financial institutions to wealth managers and private individuals. We think generationally and look to the long term. And today, building on the security of private ownership and our clear sense of purpose, we’re growing our business like never before.


Join us and you’ll be part of the progress we’re making. In our welcoming, caring culture, you’ll work with all kinds of people to find new and better ways to help our clients. Your views will be valued and your professional goals will be supported. And you’ll discover a positive, inclusive environment where you’ll be free to be yourself.

**About Fidelity Investments Canada (FIC)**


Fidelity Investments Canada (FIC) has been helping Candian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services \- and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.

**Our Values \& Behaviours**


Integrity and Trust. Together, these drive how we work with each other and with our clients, customers, and partners.


Supporting these core Values we have four action\-orientated Behaviours. Be Brave, Bold, and Curious, so that we can form a more dynamic environment where we innovate and drive performance, but nevertheless always to act with Compassion.


**About your role**


This role serves as a member of Fidelity India team, supporting Fidelity Investments Canada (FIC) CRM Support group in a Salesforce developer capacity. The CRM support group is part of IS division and provides support for Customer Relationship Management and Marketing applications for FIC.


The Salesforce developer is responsible for the development and support of the Salesforce platform. As well as continually improving and enhancing the application, working alongside the Salesforce Analyst. The incumbent is required to have a strong understanding of the Salesforce platform and a desire to keep learning.


This includes support of existing CRM and Marketing tools, evaluation and development of new solutions based on specific business requirements and rotating on\-call support for SalesForce.com and Marketo applications.


The Salesforce developer should understand all aspects of user management including support tickets, training, and designing solutions with user satisfaction a priority.


The role works closely with other team members within FIC/FCC to align with Divisional and Organizational goals.


Following are detailed responsibilities that are part of this role:

**Technical support**

* Develop comprehensive requirements to support business growth and new product functionality.
* Security minded and strong working knowledge of vulnerabilities around salesforce platform, SOQL and SOSL queries, Batch Apex and triggers, Salesforce API's(REST/SOAP/Metadata,etc), Flows, Lightning (Aura and LWC), Visual Force pages.
* Lead in definition and estimation of project work packages, including systems design specifications, overall testing and implementation plans.
* Develop and configure event management tool (Marketo)
* Complete required unit\-testing and cooperate with other business teams to ensure timely, efficient, and errors\-free implementation.
* Participate in planning and execution of CRM and Events Management tools upgrades and migrations.
* Participate in CRM support schedule, work on incident and enhancement/maintenance tickets assignments and deliver excellent technical support.
* Proactively promote enhancements to departmental processes, technical and business solutions
* Maintain solid understanding of business needs and participates in planning and execution of technical presentations and demos for our business partner
* Design and implement solutions to enhance efficiency, automation and client needs

**Application process**

* Work closely with the Salesforce Analyst to test and deliver features as required
* Identify and gather requirements from users and stakeholders
* Assists with application enhancements in understanding business requirements.
* Attends some business and technology meetings working closely with users to help identify business needs, system solutions and some cost\-benefit analysis.
* Follows the change management process for implementations and deployments
* Maintain solid understanding of business needs and participates in planning and execution of technical presentations and demos for our business partner
* Proactive system maintenance and code monitoring including security reviews, salesforce release development updates
* Design and build interfaces between salesforce platform and other applications
* Own solution delivery from technical design to production release.
* Maintain security standards and perform code reviews and constructive feedback to team

**Deliver seamless customer service through teamwork and collaboration.**

* Engage with business partners to gain understanding of their processes and objectives to deliver impactful solutions
* Accurately estimate project scope and deliver high quality solutions within agreed timelines.
* Remain focused on customer needs; communicate clearly about what you need and expect from others to serve the customer; coordinate smoothly with others; share customer information; follow through on commitments, thank team members for their efforts on behalf of the customer.
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal ownership and commitment to achieving meaningful short and long\-term results.
* Advise on best business practices for each new departmental onboarding
* Demonstrated ability to deliver well\-structured concise code, design, test, debug, deploy quality, Scalable and well\-documented solutions following industry best practices and company standards.

**Using continuous improvement methodologies, continually searches for and takes initiative to improve and/or eliminate ineffective processes to improve customer service or gain efficiencies.**

* Apply analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail to create robust components that refine and optimize processes
* Develop and implement improvements to the overall architecture and processes to drive operational efficiencies
* Document processes and procedures for internal team members to help expedite training.
* Identify gaps in day\-to\-day processes to help eliminate errors and increase efficiencies.

**About You**

**Skills and Knowledge**

* Sound knowledge and understanding about salesforce software and its functionalities.
* Extensive analytical, conceptual, and innovative problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong technical aptitude and able to adapt to new technologies quickly.
* Clear and concise communicator, both written and verbal.
* Goal\-oriented and a self\-starter.
* Ability to quickly learn, adapt and change to meet the needs of a changing environment.

**Experience and Qualifications**

**Job Related Experience**


Minimum Requirement:


5\+ years


Must Have:

* 3 to 5 years core **Salesforce** platform (LWC, Apex, Visualforce) development.
* Proven knowledge and experience with
	+ Service cloud,
	+ Sales cloud,
	+ Digital experience cloud,
	+ Community portals,
	+ Einstein GPT.
* Full\-stack web development capabilities leveraging **Java and Javascript**.
* **Agile methodology practitioner** experienced with project management tools (JIRA, Confluence) and implementing automated CI/CD pipelines for streamlined software delivery.


Nice to Have:

* Understand Salesforce DataCloud and Zero Copy architecture
* Understanding of Saas, CRM and Event Management systems architecture and development tools.
* Experience with Salesforce Financial Cloud development
* Development experience with REST Web Services
* Exposure to Events Management systems, preferably Marketo
* Wealth management, brokerage, or financial services experience.
* Completion of the Canadian Securities Course.
* Salesforce Certifications – Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II, Platform App builder, Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant

**Education:**

* First degree level (Bachelor’s degree) or equivalent in Computer Science
* Knowledge of the financial service industry

**Dynamic Working**

* This role is categorised as Hybrid (Office/Remote).

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about when and where you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team.


For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com


Or, if you’re feeling inspired, start your journey with us right now.

title: Calypso Developer
description:
About This Role
**5 to 7 years of experience**  

**Skills: Calypso, Java, Calypso Configuration, REST API, SQL, Oracle, SWIFT, MQ / JMS, Capital Markets, Trade Lifecycle, Back Office, Accounting, Git, Maven, Linux**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a Calypso Developer with 5–7 years of hands\-on Calypso development experience to design, develop, and maintain Calypso\-based solutions across our capital markets technology estate. You will combine Calypso platform expertise with strong Java and SQL skills — delivering robust, high\-quality configurations and customisations that support trading, back office, accounting, and regulatory requirements.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain Calypso platform solutions — configuration, customisation, and Java\-based extensions across trade capture, back office, and accounting modules.
* Develop and maintain Calypso interfaces — SWIFT, FIX, MQ, XML, and REST — connecting Calypso with internal and external systems.
* Write and optimise SQL queries — data validation, reconciliation, and reporting across Oracle / PostgreSQL Calypso databases.
* Configure Calypso static data — counterparty, product, account, workflow, and SSI definitions across environments.
* Support Calypso batch processing — scheduling, dependency management, and failure resolution for EOD processing cycles.
* Conduct unit testing and support UAT — validating Calypso configurations and customisations against functional specifications.
* Collaborate with BAs, architects, and operations teams — translating business requirements into well\-designed Calypso technical solutions.
* Produce clear technical documentation — configuration guides, integration specifications, and deployment runbooks.

**What We're Looking For**


* 5–7 years of hands\-on Calypso development experience in capital markets environments.


* Strong Java skills — applied to Calypso plugin development, custom workflow actions, and platform extensions.


* Good Calypso platform knowledge — trade capture, back office, accounting, or collateral modules.


* Solid SQL skills — Oracle / PostgreSQL — complex querying, stored procedures, and data validation.


* Experience with Calypso interface configuration — SWIFT, MQ, FIX, XML, or REST integrations.


* Good capital markets domain knowledge — financial instruments, trade lifecycle, and back office operations.


* Familiarity with Git, Maven, and CI/CD tooling for Calypso build and deployment.


* Good communication and collaboration skills — working effectively with BAs, architects, and operations teams.


Apply now

**Job Title\- SailPoint Developer / Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Technical Consultant**

**Experience\- 4yrs**  
**Location \-Gurgaon**

**Job Summary**   
We are seeking an experienced **SailPoint Developer** with over **4 years of hands\-on experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM)**, specializing in **SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ), RSA Aveska, and IAM Operations**. The ideal candidate will have expertise in application onboarding, access provisioning, role management, RBAC implementation, policy administration, workflow development, and user access governance within enterprise environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**SailPoint IdentityIQ Development**

* Develop and support IAM solutions using SailPoint IdentityIQ.
* Perform application onboarding for various application types including:
* Active Directory (AD)
* JDBC
* Delimited File Applications
* Configure and customize SailPoint connectors and integrations.
* Develop and maintain SailPoint rules such as:
* Customization Rules
* Creation Rules
* Correlation Rules
* Build Map Rules
* Create and manage application provisioning policies.
* Develop custom tasks and automation solutions within SailPoint.

**Identity Governance \& Administration (IGA)**

* Design and implement Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* Create and manage:
* Business Roles
* IT Roles
* Organizational Roles

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Installer cum Programmer – Home Automation**

**Department:** Projects / Technical  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR  
**Experience:** 1–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an **Installer cum Programmer – Home Automation** who will be responsible for the **installation, wiring, configuration, programming, testing and commissioning of home automation systems** at residential and commercial project sites.

The candidate should have hands\-on experience in electrical/electronic installation and a good understanding of **KNX\-based automation systems**. The role requires both **site execution and programming skills**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Home Automation Installation**

* Install and configure home automation devices and equipment at project sites.
* Carry out installation of automation modules, sensors, actuators, touch panels, switches, dimmers and other automation products.
* Perform control panel and field\-device installation as per project requirements.
* Handle wiring, termination, labelling and cable management.
* Read and understand electrical drawings, wiring diagrams and automation layouts.
* Ensure proper installation of devices as per project specifications.

**2\. KNX Programming \& Configuration**

* Perform **KNX programming and configuration** for home automation projects.
* Configure KNX devices using **ETS software**.
* Create and configure group addresses and communication objects.
* Program lighting, dimming, curtain/blind control, HVAC and other automation functions.
* Configure scenes, schedules and automation logic as required.
* Download and commission KNX programs into field devices.
* Troubleshoot KNX communication and programming\-related issues.

**3\. Testing \& Commissioning**

* Test installed automation systems and verify proper functioning.
* Commission automation systems at project sites.
* Conduct point\-to\-point testing of devices.
* Identify and rectify wiring, communication and programming issues.
* Coordinate with Project Engineers and Project Managers during commissioning.
* Ensure the system is functioning according to the approved project requirements.

**4\. Site Execution**

* Visit client/project sites for installation, programming and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with electricians, contractors, Project Engineers and other site teams.
* Ensure work is completed within the project timeline.
* Maintain proper documentation of installation and commissioning activities.
* Report site issues, material requirements and project progress to the reporting manager.

**5\. Troubleshooting \& Support**

* Diagnose hardware, wiring, network and programming\-related issues.
* Provide technical support during installation and after commissioning.
* Attend site complaints related to automation systems.
* Identify the root cause of system failures and implement appropriate solutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Hands\-on experience in **Home Automation Installation**.
* Good knowledge of **KNX automation systems**.
* Practical experience with **KNX programming and ETS software**.
* Understanding of KNX topology and bus communication.
* Knowledge of electrical wiring and termination.
* Understanding of basic networking concepts such as IP addressing, switches and LAN connectivity.
* Ability to read electrical and automation drawings.
* Knowledge of sensors, actuators, relays, dimmers and automation controllers.
* Basic troubleshooting skills for electrical, networking and automation systems.
* Ability to use basic electrical testing tools and installation tools.

**Preferred Knowledge**

Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:

* KNX
* ETS / ETS6
* DALI
* Modbus
* BACnet
* HVAC control
* Lighting control
* Curtain/Blind automation
* IP\-based automation
* Home automation gateways
* Access control
* Video door phones
* Smart home systems

**Educational Qualification**

* ITI / Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics \& Communication, Instrumentation or a related field.
* Candidates with strong practical experience in home automation may also be considered.

**Experience**

**1–5 years of relevant experience** in:

* Home Automation
* Building Automation
* Electrical Automation
* KNX Installation \& Programming
* Smart Home Installation
* ELV / Automation Projects

Freshers with strong practical KNX knowledge and relevant training may also be considered for junior positions.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong hands\-on technical skills
* Good troubleshooting ability
* Willingness to work at project sites
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Ability to understand technical drawings and project requirements
* Attention to detail
* Ability to work under project timelines
* Willingness to travel to client/project sites when required

**Key Performance Areas (KPIs)**

* Quality and accuracy of installation
* Timely completion of assigned site work
* Successful KNX programming and commissioning
* Number of installation/programming issues resolved
* Reduction in repeat site visits due to installation errors
* Proper documentation of project work
* Client/site team coordination
* Adherence to safety and project standards
